post_freeze_addenda.status: PARTIALLY WITHDRAWN -- only the 'move significance out of Gate' clause
post_freeze_addenda.proposal: Gate 1 as a screening gate (3/3 same sign, delta_mean >= 0.45, engine_win_rate >= 0.60) with significance moved to Terminal TEST
post_freeze_addenda.withdrawn_because: TEST MDE is 0.73 (FD001, 100 engines) and 0.60 (FD004, 248 engines), still above 0.45 -- moving significance to TEST merely relocates an unreachable condition and burns the single TEST shot
post_freeze_addenda.consequence: frozen criteria restored including 'CI excludes 0'; the rest of the v7.2 material (power ceiling, estimator note, required-n, 5-fold exclusion) remains valid
still_valid: option '5-fold out-of-fold x5 samples' is excluded (5 clusters)
estimator note: analytic MDE vs bootstrap CI differ by 0.3-3.8%
reporting: every table reports MDE and p_null (report item, not a criterion)
wording: 'underpowered under this protocol' is not 'module invalid'; INCONCLUSIVE may not be rewritten as PASS nor used to relax thresholds

power_ceiling.statement: C-MAPSS 验证集在数学上装不下 0.45 这个效应量；此结论在 B 段开跑前就已可算，属于事前已知的设计限制，不是事后发现。
power_ceiling.required_engines: 250-900 (worst cell about 900; per-cell SD(d) FD001 2.54-3.35, FD004 3.47-4.82)
power_ceiling.effective_gate: CI excluding 0 effectively demands delta_mean about 1.1, i.e. 2.4x the stated 0.45
power_ceiling.test_mde: 0.73 (FD001, 100 engines) / 0.60 (FD004, 248 engines) -- still above 0.45, so moving significance to TEST does not make 0.45 testable
power_ceiling.excluded_option: 5-fold out-of-fold x5 samples: 100 OOF predictions come from 5 models (5 clusters); naive bootstrap under-covers and a 5-cluster bootstrap cannot give a usable 95% CI
power_ceiling.estimator_note: MDE is analytic 2.8*SD/sqrt(n); the CI is bootstrap percentile; within a cell they differ by 0.3-3.8%

two_stage.grey_band: 0.45-0.73 is outside the scope of any claim
two_stage.note: record field only, must never flow back into the Gate verdict

reporting_rules.winners_curse_inflation: passing cells are inflated by 0.16-0.24 (mean of passing cells 0.61-0.69 at sigma*lambda, sigma 0.34-0.45)
reporting_rules.p_null: p(delta_mean >= 0.45 | true effect 0) = 18.1-28.1% single seed, 5.7-15.7% for the three-seed mean
reporting_rules.per_table: every table reports MDE and p_null = 1 - Phi(0.45/SE)

branch_order.rule: determinate failures are classified BEFORE any CI test; only a cell passing all three screening conditions can reach the CI branch
order: then CI: consistent | underpowered | powered_but_null | determinately_worse
branch_order.wording: FAIL is 'not demonstrated'; only genuine underpowered votes may be described as 'not measurable under this protocol'

ncmapss_unit_count.finding: N-CMAPSS has FEWER independent units than C-MAPSS, so it cannot buy statistical power
ncmapss_unit_count.implication: the Stage 2 rationale cannot be 'more units'; the real gain is longer degradation trajectories per unit, and the existing split_units 5-fold protocol on 6 units yields 1-2 unit folds and must be redesigned (leave-one-unit 6-fold is the only non-pseudo-replicated option)
